BISMUTHUM.

Hydrated  oxide  of  Bismuth.  Bi^O^OH^-

Hahnemann  proved  with  his  students  and  published  the  result  in  1827,
what  he  supposed  to  be  pure  wismuth  oxide,  but  what  now  is  known  as
